description:
First-filed versus latest-filed metric delta

Return the change in one metric between a reporting period's first-filed figures and its latest-filed figures, across the SEC filings that reported it. Market-dependent derived metrics are rejected on this EDGAR-only route.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193). Send this or `ticker`, not both.

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Names the period to compare when the identity reports more than one: a fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods, and each is compared across filings on its own. Without it the comparison covers the later period. A date that names no period of the identity answers 404, listing the dates in `details.available_statement_dates`.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol naming the company, in place of `cik`; send one or the other. Resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

name: analysis_version_delta
